questions.title: What does a hint cost the player?
questions.explanation: A hint can be free, cost points, or be limited per game. This sets how the score is kept.

choices.label: Costs points
choices.description: Each hint takes 2 points off the question.

thread.author: owner
thread.text: Do hints work on timed questions?

thread.author: claude
thread.text: Yes. The timer keeps running while a hint is open.

questions.title: Where do hints come from?
questions.explanation: Hints are written by hand with the question, or generated when asked for.

choices.label: Written with the question
choices.description: Authors add a hint when they add a question.

choices.label: Generated on request
choices.description: A model writes the hint when the player asks.

answer.text: Written, and the author can mark a question as hint-free.

questions.title: How many hints per question?
questions.explanation: One hint keeps it simple; several give a way to step up from vague to exact.

choices.label: Up to three
choices.description: Each hint is more explicit than the last.

decisions.decision: Hints are written with the question
decisions.why: A model call per hint is too costly.

decisions.decision: A hint costs 2 points, never below zero

answers.text: Do hints work on timed questions?
Written, and the author can mark a question as hint-free.
